hook_text: One school fete, every Term 1 skill. From the ticket gate to the raffle in sixty seconds.
clip_script: Fete in Mahikeng. Gate: tickets in books of 25, twelve books, count in steps, 300. Saturday sold 2 468. The 4 is worth 400, it is even, and to the nearest 100 it is 2 500. Till: Saturday plus Sunday, 2 468 plus 1 795, columns from the units, carry past 9, 4 263. Estimate 4 300, close. How many more on Saturday? Take away 1 800, give back 5: 673. Check by adding back. Stalls: 24 stalls at R6, split 24 into 20 and 4, 120 plus 24, 144 rand. Hall: 23 rows of 14 seats, grid, four boxes, 322. Raffle: 24 prizes in equal rows, factors of 24, eight ways. Every skill in the term, used at one fete. Estimate first, check with the inverse, and the test is just another fete.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of a fete with each stall lighting up as its skill appears; small sums written beside each landmark.
mood: Energetic recap, a tour with a purpose.
pacing: Six fast stops around the fete, one skill each, then the two-habit rule.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make your own one-page map of Term 1 before the test.
